copy.curiosityHook: Pushed to the brink of extinction, can two cautious kingdoms hold their ground against Cao's massive unified assault?
copy.description: In 208 A.D., Prime Minister Cao convinces the Han Emperor to wage an unprecedented war against rival southern and western territories, forcing the outnumbered kingdoms of Xu and East Wu into a desperate mutual defense.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, heavy historical action that demands engaged attention for massive battlefield stakes.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by John Woo, this sprawling historical epic delivers grand tactical warfare and high-stakes momentum as rival kingdoms unite to avert total annihilation.

allowedMaterial: In 208 A.D. during the final days of the Han Dynasty
Prime Minister Cao convincing the Emperor to wage war on Xu and East Wu
Unlikely alliance formed by Xu and East Wu out of necessity for survival
John Woo direction and genre framing
excludedMaterial: Fate of Prime Minister Cao or individual commanders
Final fate of the Han Dynasty or allied kingdoms
